objective: Before human review, proactively correct confirmed errors, incompleteness, and semantic or reference mismatches in the simply-connected premodular numerical theorem and its modular specialization.

confirmed_corrections.reason: EGNO Lemma 8.22.9(ii) states that alpha is a group homomorphism; it does not itself choose a finite-simple-skeleton representative of each integral tensor power. The retained input is standard Picard-group closure plus simple-skeleton representability.
The wrapper theorem is derived from the preceding standard representability input and therefore should not carry an EGNO attribution.
The identity q(g^n)=q(g)^(n^2) is a standard consequence of ribbon balancing, duality, and the quadratic-form definition; EGNO Definition 8.4.1 does not state this Lean theorem verbatim.
The cited source is Etingof--Nikshych--Ostrik, On fusion categories, Theorem 2.3, applied to the Mueger-center fusion subcategory.
The exact cited source is Etingof--Nikshych--Ostrik, On fusion categories, Theorem 2.3.
The equation dim(1)=1 is a standard consequence of pivotal-trace normalization and unit coherence, not a verbatim numbered EGNO theorem in the form formerly suggested by the name.
